About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: An Information Technology professional and researcher specializing in Election Technology, Digital Democracy, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity.
About.description: I am passionate about modernizing election systems through secure digital technologies, AI-driven solutions, cybersecurity, and data-driven decision making. My mission is to contribute to transparent, trustworthy, and resilient election systems that strengthen democratic institutions.
